name: PuffinMail for WooCommerce
author: puffinmail

sections.description:
Connect your store to PuffinMail in one step. The plugin keeps your customers, orders and carts in sync so you can:

  • Grow your list with a consent checkbox at checkout and in My Account (works with the block checkout).
  • Win back abandoned carts with two timed reminders, a one-click link that restores the cart, and an optional single-use coupon.
  • Send birthday emails with a unique coupon.
  • Segment by orders, total spent and last order date.
  • Keep unsubscribes in sync both ways.

Syncing happens in the background, so it never slows down your shop, and nothing is lost if PuffinMail is briefly unreachable.

External services

This plugin connects your store to PuffinMail (https://puffinmail.co), an email marketing service for online stores. It needs a PuffinMail account; it does nothing until you paste a PuffinMail API key in its settings.

Once connected, it sends to PuffinMail’s Store API (https://my.puffinmail.co/api/v1):

  • Customers and guest buyers: name, email address, phone, billing address, language, newsletter status and consent record (time, IP address, sign-up wording), birthday if collected, and order totals. Sent when they are created or change. Existing customers and orders are sent only when you start a history sync (the last 12 months, 3 years or everything).
  • Orders: items, totals, status changes and refunds, when they happen.
  • Carts that are abandoned: the cart contents and the customer’s email address, so reminder emails can be sent.
  • Products: name, price, image, stock and categories, so emails can show them. The whole catalogue is sent once when you connect, then each change.

It also adds PuffinMail’s storefront script (https://my.puffinmail.co/s.js) to your shop’s pages. The script records page visits and product views for your store’s PuffinMail account, and shows your PuffinMail signup forms. For customers who arrived from a PuffinMail email or are signed in, visits are linked to their contact. It sets a first-party cookie (pm_vid, one year). You can turn it off under WooCommerce > Settings > PuffinMail, and with a consent plugin that supports the WP Consent API it only loads for visitors who allow statistics cookies.

PuffinMail sends signed requests back to your store (to /wp-json/puffinmail/v1/webhook) when someone unsubscribes, so your store stays in sync.

PuffinMail: Terms of Service, Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. In PuffinMail (my.puffinmail.co), go to Stores and create an API key.
  3. In WordPress, go to WooCommerce > Settings > PuffinMail, paste the key and save.
  4. Click “Sync last 12 months” to bring in your existing customers and orders.
sections.faq:
Does syncing subscribe my customers to the newsletter?

No. Customers are only subscribed when they tick the sign-up box. Every customer is synced as a contact so order and cart emails can reach them, and you choose whether cart and birthday emails go to subscribers only.

What data is shared with PuffinMail?

Name, email address, billing address, phone, order history and, for abandoned carts, the cart contents. See the suggested privacy policy text under Settings > Privacy.
sections.changelog:
0.3.0

  • Your discount codes are sent to PuffinMail, so its signup forms (like spin to win) and emails can offer your real codes and warn about expired or used-up ones. Codes made for one customer are never sent.
  • The text domain is the directory slug, puffinmail-for-woocommerce, so the plugin can be translated on translate.wordpress.org.
  • The “API key was rejected” notice shows only on the Dashboard, the Plugins screen and WooCommerce’s screens.

0.2.1

  • Tested with WordPress 7.1 and WooCommerce 11.2.
  • The storefront script is loaded with wp_enqueue_script, only from my.puffinmail.co, and honours the WP Consent API.
  • The “Connect your store” notice can be dismissed.
  • Cart reminder emails can’t be requested for many addresses from one visitor.
  • Uninstalling removes all of the plugin’s data.

0.2.0

  • Product catalogue sync, for product blocks and recommendations in emails.
  • The PuffinMail storefront script: visits from emails, browse-abandonment emails, and signup forms ([puffinmail_form id=”…”]).

0.1.0

  • First release.
